ajadapramatrsiddhi: “What in things themselves distinguishes real from unreal, conscious from unconscious?” — the question the text opens on. Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8). What never stood cannot stand another: consciousness fits itself to this and I, orders inert selves by double certainty, and completes severed grasping in self-rest (vv10-15). Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).
anubhavanivedana: “Mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim; seeing yet not seeing with steady gaze — this is śāmbhavī mudrā by the guru's grace alone: reality free of void and non-void.” — the question the text opens on. Mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim; seeing yet not seeing with steady gaze — this is śāmbhavī mudrā by the guru's grace alone: reality fr Four outer strokes — half-open eyes, steady mind, nose-tip gaze, moon-sun dissolved — then the vision: light-form without exterior, one supr No technique enjoined: whatever sounds is already transcendent mantra, whatever the body postures is already mudrā, whatever the breath's fl Each sacred form defined by a vanishing: mantra where letters unnoticed, mudrā where all bodily action dissolved, yoga where breath-flow exh
anuttarastika: “What is the method, if no method is enjoined?” — the question the text opens on. No method is enjoined: contemplation, speech-connection, discussion, visualization, steadying, japa-practice-effort — all denied. Saṃsāra is unreal for the embodied; bondage never truly is for anyone, so the liberation-rite is false. Worship, worshipper, worshipped — what difference-course in the unsurpassed? Bliss is neither wealth-intoxication nor lamp-sun-moon splendour. Passions through misery — the whole catalogue of feeling-states, universe-bodied — are not different-natured. Former non-being, being, action — things always, suddenly here, middle-formed and confused: whence their truth? Of things no arising; naturally they shine by your contemplation, even the non-true borrowing momentary truth.
bhairavanukarana: “Who is saluted, and who should shelter?” — the question the text opens on. Salute, shelter, wander-not; grace conquers. Her spread: Brahmī-led all. Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me. Thread-loosed sapless shown garlanded as-if. Doubled look commands; gut- Boon-hand glory-giving; unstained principle-fixed. Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if. Ghoul-girt measuring shown; Bhairava-am-I.
bhairavastava: “What is the object of veneration, and how does veneration relate to it?” — the question the text opens on. Bhairava is established as all-pervading conscious reality: one, endless, beginningless — the Absolute that pervades moving and unmoving states. Grace first discloses the world as His, without remainder, now — then identity is declared outright: Maheśa, always my self, and all mine through Him. Fear-talk is denied while suffering is conceded: with You as Lord pervading own self, no talk of transmigration-fear. Death's gaze is turned aside by prayer: O Ender, do not direct this wrathful-terrible gaze toward me. Darkness already burned away by awareness; four terrors then met with salutation alone, yielding absolute fearlessness. True awakening discloses things as they are: its rays reveal the true essence of world-objects.
bodhapancadasika: “What never sets, and who dwells within it?” — the question the text opens on. Unsetting light holds bright and dark alike; one inward reality bounds both. He alone beings' own-nature; the world's abundance power cast as sovereignty. Power refuses parting; eternal identity, fire-sealed. World-bearing His mark; whole mirrored by power in self-seeing. His goddess, grasp-eager, fills all exactly — never short, never over. Play-eager pair make-unmake varied worlds simultaneously, everywhere. Hardest deed, unsurpassed: autonomy, lordship, awareness-form in one. Partial shining marks inert; measure-evading awareness differs. Change self-abides: stood as nature, arrived without departing. Variety totalized: extremes, three directions, outer-inner one list. Mis-knowing described as freedom; bondage dreadful-to-fools, nothing second. Three doors unranked; whichever arrival counts.
bodhavilasa: “Who is saluted first?” — the question the text opens on. Double invocation: Netra, five-act Śiva. Free cause so-called; powers bestowed. Own ground-will-purpose; fitness divides. Variety arranged h Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds. Always-practice frees to bliss-fullness. Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known. Joined attains pure soon, doubtless. Grown fire shi Middle-opening means powerful thought-decay, many ways. Non-dual nectar drunk quenches fever. Pure method-treatise for winning Śiva.
ghatakarpara: “Is desire and absence one event or two?” — the question the text opens on. Śṛṅgāra is performed, not described: the separated beloved's voice, her appeal to the cloud, and the landscape's answering her are all determinants (vibhāva) of the rasa. Beauty is not decoration but cause: the groves shine for Kāma's sake, not the reverse. The rasa shifts from śṛṅgāra to vira/adbhuta: love and landscape are framed by the poet's skill, not by love alone.
isvarasiddhi: “Under what auspice does the Lord's proof open?” — the question the text opens on. Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2). Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11). Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22). Potter necessary, nature watching, helpers insufficient, wisdom and will required, sufficiency tested (vv28-33). Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
kramastotra: “What rite ends sorrow?” — the question the text opens on. Completion-rite amid sorrow; mirrored mind drops fear. Redoubled self-scrutiny: effortless standing in hymn. Unscrutinized sterility vs shining Śiva one-sapped: bliss follows scrutiny. Omniscience effortlessly gained; heart bidden to speak the hymn. Bond-conceit shaken, difference burnt, glory drunk: madness-bliss. Unhymnable held, hymned sudden: bowing first means. Fire-unburning nobodies; knowing-rays praised each-owned. Unpartitioned taste, unopposed floods, priceless knowing. Difference-fled form; heart-and-speech vowed. Inner ocean; triple lights rise-set at once. Power undivided walking; heart one-pointed on still ground. Whole-to-difference by will; praise melts fear Śiva-made. Thisness-form; sequencelessness melts time; all instruments at once. Swelled sequence shown; triple-becoming prayed for overlaying.
pancashloki: “The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked.” — the question the text opens on. The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked. Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to bec Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free. Against the silence stand two testimonies — the guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance — whose force wipes away piled-up reasonings; w Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.
paramarthacarca: “Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention.” — the question the text opens on. Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere conventi No thing stands dually apart from knowledge; in consciousness there is no difference; the individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, s Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated pow Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mounta If even a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established, the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things O consciousness…
paramarthasara: “To whom take refuge?” — the question the text opens on. Refuge in all-abiding Śambhu; whirled student asks, teacher answers in verses. Thought-free principle shines the thirty-six like mirror-towns; freedom effects the hard, Māyā veils; grasped knowing stains sixfold; the at Five knowing, five doing organs; subtle division-free objects; mixture grossifies; creation husks consciousness; three sheaths wrap; one sel Unreal orders arise by delusion; shining-things darkness takes non-self for self, burst upon burst; self nets itself spider-like; unwrapped, Seeming follows states, Lord truly not; mirroring removed, delusion shattered; rooted done, no duty; triad remainders into being; difference I drive the play-wheel pure-formed; in-me shining, from-me spreading; universe-formed shining in all; senseless seer composing systems; cros Done fruitless ends birth; freed seed unsprouting; own-form…
parapravesika: “What consciousness is venerated, and under which form?” — the question the text opens on. The vow binds deity to doctrine in one compound and predicates contraries together — world-shaped yet world-surpassing consciousness, throbb Light-nature entails awareness-nature: specified twofold and three-functioned as unmade-I flashing, the calm-brahman alternative refused, ab Ten scriptural names, one awareness-primacy: each name denotes by its office — chief-form, speech, ground-fullness, join-loose-lower, no-oth Self-lit Lord shines by the Lady as śiva-to-earth world; that shining constitutes both making and aliveness; effecthood resolved as shining- The prover proved before proof: indicators cannot touch, questions answer themselves, proof demoted to illusion's traffic, outlived by the f Full-I-grasp woven of a-to-ha sound-mass grounds identity: Śiva Himself the thirty-six-leveled display;…
paryantapancasika: “What speech is studied?” — the question the text opens on. Rest-filled unspeakable studied as heart. Sundered knowings varied-shine for knower. Limited called bound; willed measured. Limited follows; stations gained contracted. Particular fancy arisen; purified trace holding. Fashion Withdrawn tending attains face-to-face. Boundless welcomed entered; imagine-not vowed. Streamed lakes dived; inert stirred. Five-doing trust Measured-unmeasured contemplated; supreme freedom trusted. Subtle-five tooled ten by touch. Veiled-shown depends; ebb-flow conditions. Longed union arose; else supreme. Four bear inside triśaṅku-hung Rested-rested emitted indeed. Hidden mirror speaks pure publishing once. Triple time self-drawn out and in. Split-whole beheld; seeing agenc Place-struck natured being; heard Vaikharī doings.
phrdaya: “How does free consciousness become the bound knower?” — the question the text opens on. Free consciousness causes, unborrowing opens, divides by fitness, veils by tightening — descent promised. Mind tightened, knower measured, pentads stationed, schools seated on the descent. Stained likeness keeps divine office: five acts done small is wandering. Return climbs, burns, owns, holds fast — freedom alive. Opening middle, given means, recalled oneness, become Śiva.
sambandhasiddhi: “Under what auspice does the inquiry into relation open?” — the question the text opens on. Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5). Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11). Secondaries measured against chiefs — king's man, brahmin's; other chiefs, other unities — king's horse, man (vv19-20).
sivastotravali: “Must love wait for method?” — the question the text opens on. Devotion stands rule-free and self-young: undawned by method, unaged by road-dust, at home in the Lord's city, thriving on every ground (vv1-6). Twenty-nine salutations perform the all-self: every stuff of the world — fire, moon, gods, still, moving — named as His, every verse landing bowed (whole song). The third beyond being and non-being: leap the two-yoked course; freedom contagious among the unfree — Thy hangers-on live free (vv01-02, v18). Confession and approach: fickle mind praised for refuge-worship, low ground kept past gods' stairs, one road begged with world-doings shuttered (vv1-3). Approaching touches: foot-brush joined, dust-dyed hair, dumb dwelling, shouted dance, half-shut gaping, mountain-mind, Her town, opening heart-lotus (vv1-8).
spandasandoha: “Who alone is victorious, tasting the inner face?” — the question the text opens on. Śiva alone, possessing spanda, self-established, makes the inner face taste; this hero, lord of the Kula, is victorious.
tantrasara-a01: “Whom invoke, and what flash forth?” — the question the text opens on. Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship.
tantrasara-a02: “What comes first, and what is promised?” — the question the text opens on. The way with no way: when grace has struck firm, one word from the teacher and the immersion is ever-risen — no means required.
